category_title: Students with color-blind racial ideologies in diverse group settings
scenario_title: Group discussion on interview design and diversity
minimal_context: The student is writing a weekly journal entry reflecting on her group's progress in discussing interview questions and interviewee selection for their research project.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For this week's journal, please reflect on your group's progress in discussing interview questions and interviewee selection for the research project.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have some mean and terrible thoughts about Charles. Because this is a journal entry, I feel the freedom to express these thoughts.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please explain what happened during your group meeting.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: When we were discussing interview questions Charles contributed that he felt there was no racial diversity on our campus and depending on the age and race of the student we interviewed, they would have different answers. He got really loud and rambled on in an increasingly dominant voice about how he was Hispanic and older.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How did you respond to his comments?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: On the discussion boards he talks about how he wants team cohesion so we can work better together yet he continually mentions his race and age. I am just disregarding his words. I don't understand this, we're all different and come from different backgrounds. Race shouldn't matter and we should see past it.

dialogue_combined:

He got really loud and rambled on in an increasingly dominant voice about how he was Hispanic and older.
